findings.text: 🟠 [p26-suite-evidence-missing] MUST-FIX The README progress row claims "P2.6 suites green" and the verification map makes "reaper/registry suites green" the C5 evidence, but p2-green-B.txt records rc lines for only ten suites; dispatch-detach, dispatch-worktree-lifecycle, dispatch-hetero-gc, worktree-reap, repo-residue-sweep, tmp-residue-registry, check-tmp-residue-registry, suite-residue-reaper, prune-tmp-residue, foreman-guard and test-doc-drift-gate have no recorded run anywhere in the artifact, so the C5 claim that every reaper still reclaims the relocated worktrees is unverified and the g1 seat that raised this was never answered. Smallest remediation: run those suites one at a time and append their rc lines to p2-green-B.txt (or amend the README row to name exactly which suites ran and mark the rest pending before P2 closes).

🔵 [resolver-non-builtin-require] CUT/FOLLOW-UP P2.1 pins "Node, built-ins only" for the resolver, yet it requires ../src/status/project-key for repo identity; the module ships in-repo and all green suites exercise it, so no failure today. Record the deviation in the README deviations list; excluded because reusing the stored identity function is what D5 already asked for and inlining it would fork the identity rule.

🔵 [d10-invalid-marker-still-skipped] CUT/FOLLOW-UP The busy-skip in repo-residue-sweep.js keys on marker_valid !== true, so a cwd-busy nested worktree with a present-but-malformed marker is still hidden from needs_human, while D10 says "without a marker". Direction is conservative (nothing is reaped) and untested; excluded from this version.

🔵 [batch-first-run-case] CUT/FOLLOW-UP No explicit batch first-run (no .claude/) case; batch has no main-checkout fingerprint so main_checkout_mutated cannot occur there, and the R6 sandbox is freshly created so the merge-back assertion is already a first-placement run. Add the one-line reason to moved-assertions.md; not a defect.

🟠 [p26-suite-evidence-gap] MUST-FIX The README progress row (in this diff) asserts "P2.6 suites green", but the cited evidence `p2-green-B.txt` records rc for only 10 suites (resolver, identifier-scan, probe-unknown, worktree-activity, orchestrator-edit-gate, repo-residue-auto, the three rail suites + contract); the spec P2.6/C5 verification surfaces `dispatch-detach`, `dispatch-worktree-lifecycle`, `dispatch-hetero-gc`, `worktree-reap`, `repo-residue-sweep`, `tmp-residue-registry`, `check-tmp-residue-registry`, `suite-residue-reaper`, `prune-tmp-residue`, `foreman-guard` and `test-doc-drift-gate.sh` have no recorded run — and D9 edited the very files (`tmp-residue-allowlist.json`, registry JSON) those gates validate, while D10 changed `repo-residue-sweep.js` itself (only `repo-residue-auto` covers it). Impact: C5's "every reaper, the residue registry and repo-residue-sweep still reclaim them" and the D9/D10 surfaces are claimed green without evidence, so a reaper/registry regression ships under a passing record. Smallest remediation: run the missing suites one at a time and append their rc=0 lines to `p2-green-B.txt` (or amend the README row to name exactly which suites ran and that the rest are pending before P2 closes).

🔵 [resolver-non-builtin-require] CUT/FOLLOW-UP Plan P2.1 pins "Node, built-ins only" for `resolve-repo-placement.js`, but it `require`s `../src/status/project-key`; behaviour is `--from`-based and pinned by tests ("two repos named proj get different manual paths") and every green rail suite exercises the path, so there is no current failure — verify that require graph stays dependency-free (or inline the identity computation) so the resolver keeps working in depless checkouts; excluded from this version because the module ships beside the script in-repo.

🔵 [d10-invalid-marker] CUT/FOLLOW-UP `repo-residue-sweep.js` busy-skip now keys on `marker_valid !== true`, so a cwd-busy nested worktree whose marker file exists but is malformed is listed in needs_human rather than busy-skipped — a conservative, visible direction (nothing is reaped from a listing), no test exercises it; excluded from this version, note it in walkers.md or the D10 row if it matters later.

🔵 [p26-suite-evidence-gap] CUT/FOLLOW-UP README progress row asserts "P2.6 suites green" and points at p2-green-B.txt, which records rc=0 for ten suites; plan §3 P2.6 enumerates more (dispatch-detach, dispatch-worktree-lifecycle, dispatch-hetero-gc, worktree-reap, repo-residue-sweep, tmp-residue-registry, check-tmp-residue-registry, suite-residue-reaper, prune-tmp-residue, foreman-guard, test-doc-drift-gate). The reaper code in this diff is unchanged and enumerates by basename (worktree-reap.sh:613, repo-residue-sweep.js, etc.), so the claims are defensible; this is evidence completeness, not a code defect. Remediation: append the missing rc lines to p2-green-B.txt (or amend the row to name the suites with recorded evidence) once the plan sees P3/P4. Excluded from this version.

🔵 [resolver-non-builtin-require] CUT/FOLLOW-UP Plan P2.1 pins "Node, built-ins only — it runs on rail paths" for scripts/resolve-repo-placement.js, but the script does `require('../src/status/project-key')`. Behavior is correct (handoff keys are validated by tests pin "manual: two repos named proj get different paths"), but the constraint text is violated. If project-key or its transitive require graph ever grows an npm dependency, the resolver breaks in depless checkouts. Remediation: verify project-key's require graph stays devDeps-free, or inline the small scopeFromCwd computation used by the `main` and `handoff` paths. Excluded from the current version.

🔵 [d10-malformed-marker-conservative] CUT/FOLLOW-UP D10 reads "Skip only worktrees without an .autopilot-worktree marker"; the code keys on `w.marker_valid !== true`, which also busy-skips a cwd-busy worktree whose marker exists but is malformed (hidden from needs_human), deviating slightly from the spec letter. Direction is conservative (nothing gets reaped behind a malformed marker), no test exercises the malformed-marker path, and the assertion set in repo-residue-auto.test.sh still pins the intended behaviour. Remediation: tighten to `!w.marker` (presence, not validity) if/when a test is added; excluded from this version.

🟠 [p26-c5-evidence-gap] MUST-FIX README progress row asserts "P2.6 suites green" and the spec C5 requires "every reaper, the residue registry and repo-residue-sweep still reclaim them", but `p2-green-B.txt` records rc=0 for only 10 suites (resolve-repo-placement, identifier-scan, probe-unknown, worktree-activity, orchestrator-edit-gate, repo-residue-auto, dispatch-batch, dispatch-foreman, dispatch-hetero-contract, dispatch-hetero). The plan §3 P2.6 list also names dispatch-detach, dispatch-worktree-lifecycle, dispatch-hetero-gc, worktree-reap, repo-residue-sweep, tmp-residue-registry, check-tmp-residue-registry, suite-residue-reaper, prune-tmp-residue, foreman-guard and test-doc-drift-gate — none have recorded runs in the diff. Impact: C5's reaper/registry reclamation claim and the D9/D10 surfaces are asserted green without evidence; a regression in those suites would ship under a passing record. Smallest remediation: run each missing suite one at a time and append its rc=0 line to `docs/plans/evidence/2026-10-12-worktree-placement/p2-green-B.txt` (or amend the README row to name exactly which suites ran and mark the rest pending before P2 closes).
